faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RINPAS Director recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the RINPAS Director position is 08-09-2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Director post at RINPAS?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Director, RINPAS post will receive a salary of Rs. 144200 Per Month, which is at Level-14.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum experience requirements for the Director position?
faq.answer: A minimum of 15 years of teaching, research, or practical experience in a Psychiatry Institute/Medical College, including as a Professor, is required. Additionally, at least 2 years as HOD, Medical Superintendent, Dean, or Unit Head is necessary.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the available information, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Director post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Director, RINPAS post is 65 years. However, retired officials may be considered up to 70 years.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Director position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Director, RINPAS post is through Direct Recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from outside Jharkhand apply for this post?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any domicile restrictions. Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria are encouraged to apply.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Director, RINPAS post is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for RINPAS Director recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Official Notification PDF" link provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of RINPAS?
faq.answer: The official website of RINPAS is part of the Jharkhand government portal, which can be accessed at https://www.jharkhand.gov.in.
